test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A) Due to this, social approaches too have changed a lot.

B) Social reformers have brought in significant changes in society.

C) But a complete transformation is yet awaited ever after centuries.

D) We are now witnessing transformations on a larger scale.
solution:
The correct answer is "**BADC.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph discusses the changes in society brought about by social reformers.
 
• Sentence B introduces the idea of social reformers bringing significant changes.
 
• Sentence A further explains that these changes have affected social approaches.
 
• Sentence D states that we are currently witnessing larger scale transformations.
 
• Sentence C concludes the paragraph by stating that a complete transformation is still awaited.
 
• Thus, the correct order will be "BADC."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.
